market_outlook.short_term: Cautious. Warsh's hawkish tone keeps rate-cut expectations at bay, pressuring rate-sensitive sectors. Retail earnings week and Apple Sept 9 event provide volatility catalysts. Gold/silver continue orderly rally. Consumer data likely soft. Expect range-bound equities with sector rotation into defense, AI, and precious metals.
market_outlook.long_term: Constructive but bifurcated. AI/robotics capex and defense spending provide structural growth. Dollar debasement and fiscal concerns support gold, EM bonds, and real assets. Consumer weakness may moderate through 2027. China overcapacity in solar/energy creates dislocation opportunities. Fed likely holds rates 1-2 quarters longer than market expects.
